name: note to CC toggle
about: Each press of note 36 flips CC 80 between 127 and 0 on the note's own channel, and the release sends nothing.
notes: toggle note 36 cc 80 on 127 off 0. The first press sends on. State is per link, per op and per channel.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 30, 99 24 00 is a note on at velocity 0, which is a RELEASE, so it is dropped and does not flip.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 50 and t 60, note 38 is not note 36 and passes as a note.
NEGATIVE CONTROL t 70, note 36 on channel 1 has its own state, so its first press sends on: B0 50 7F, not off.
